name: gulf-hijri-date
title: Gulf Hijri date
description: A date typed once and shown in Gregorian and Umm al-Qura Hijri. The time zone is required.
docs: Needs a shadcn project (Tailwind and the shadcn CSS variables). Works with and without `shadcn init --rtl`: set dir="rtl" on <html> or a parent for Arabic. Pass every label, help text and error message as props.
